POND'S BB+ Cream | Instant Spot Coverage.description:
"Pond's BB+ Cream: Your Complete 3-in-1 Secret to Flawless Skin Pond's BB+ Cream: Cover. Care. Protect. is a breakthrough in daily beauty, offering a seamless blend of cosmetic perfection and advanced skincare. More than just a light foundation, this innovative formula embodies the triple power you need for a radiant, healthy-looking complexion. Experience the freedom of flawless skin without the weight or fuss of multiple products. The Triple Power: Cover. Care. Protect. COVER: Instant Perfection, Effortless Glow The cream’s sophisticated tint immediately addresses visible skin concerns. It provides instant, natural-looking coverage to visibly conceal spots, blemishes, and minor imperfections. Blending effortlessly into the skin, it ensures an even skin tone and delivers a coveted light make-up glow, replacing the heavy feel of traditional foundation with a breathable, radiant finish. CARE: Nourishment from Within We believe your coverage should also be your care. This formula is actively enriched with key skincare ingredients. Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) works diligently beneath the surface to actively care for your skin, helping to improve overall texture, strengthen the skin barrier, and minimize the appearance of pores. Complementing this is Glycerine, a powerful humectant that provides essential, deep hydration, ensuring your skin remains soft, supple, and deeply nourished throughout the day. PROTECT: Daily Defense Against Damage A truly complete cream must offer defense. Infused with SPF 30 PA++, the Pond's BB+ Cream offers superior, broad-spectrum protection against environmental aggressors. This potent shield guards your skin from the harmful effects of both UVA and UVB rays, actively helping to prevent sun damage, premature aging, and the formation of dark spots. Achieve a visibly radiant, youthful, and protected complexion every day with this indispensable all-in-one cream." "FAQ:- Can I wear POND'S BB+ Cream without foundation? Yes. POND'S BB+ Cream already combines a vitamin-enriched cream with a lightweight foundation, so it can be worn alone for buildable light coverage and a natural make-up glow. Apply one thin layer across your face, add another only where needed, and set it with compact powder if desired. Is POND'S BB+ Cream Ivory suitable for my skin tone? POND'S BB+ Cream in Ivory is intended for light to medium skin tones. If your skin tone falls between medium and medium-deep, the Natural shade may be more suitable. Both shades provide buildable light coverage and a natural finish, but the final shade match should be checked against your complexion. Is POND'S BB+ Cream suitable for oily or dry skin? Yes. POND'S BB+ Cream has a balanced, non-oily and non-pore-clogging formula that is suitable for all skin types. It contains Glycerine to help maintain moisture and uses a lightweight foundation for coverage. Apply it to cleansed, dry skin and blend evenly for a smooth-looking finish. 4. Does POND'S BB+ Cream provide sun protection? Yes. POND'S BB+ Cream contains SPF 30 PA++, which helps protect the skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays. It combines this protection with vitamin-enriched skincare and lightweight make-up coverage. Apply it evenly during your daytime routine to obtain the product’s intended coverage and finish. 6. Does POND'S BB+ Cream cover dark spots and dark circles? POND'S BB+ Cream provides instant spot coverage through its lightweight foundation and helps conceal blemishes and dark circles. Its coverage is light and buildable, so you can add a thin second layer where more camouflage is needed. The formula is also clinically proven to brighten skin and reduce dark spots. 7. Which ingredients are in POND'S BB+ Cream and what do they do? POND'S BB+ Cream contains Vitamin B3 or Niacinamide to support brightness and even-looking skin, Vitamin E to nourish, Allantoin to soothe and Glycerine to maintain moisture. The formula also contains SPF 30 PA++ and a lightweight foundation for UV protection, instant coverage and a natural glow. 8. Can I apply POND'S BB+ Cream at night? No. POND'S BB+ Cream should be removed before sleeping so your skin can continue its regular overnight routine without make-up. Use a gentle cleanser to remove the product thoroughly, then apply your usual night care. POND'S recommends the BB+ Cream for convenient everyday or daytime coverage instead."

  • Sun Protection: Features SPF 30 PA++ for superior defense against damaging UVA and UVB rays, preventing sun damage and darkening.

Tata Soulfull Masala Oats+ With Millets,.title: Tata Soulfull Masala Oats+ With Millets, Desi Veggie, 500g, Real Vegetables, 25% Millets, Non Sticky, Evening Snack, Healt...
Tata Soulfull Masala Oats+ With Millets,.description:
Drive your evening snack craving away, the DESI-LICIOUS way with TATA SOULFULL MASALA OATS+. Tata Soulfull Masala Oats+ Desi Veggie combines the goodness of whole grain oats, crunchy Indian millets (jowar & Navane), desi masalas, and 100% real veggies. It’s a mouth-watering desi snack bursting with taste and texture! Ready in just 4 minutes, this ready-to-eat Masala Oats is super convenient to prepare and also high in fiber and a good source of protein. Why Millets? Jowar, also known as sorghum, is a popular millet in the north that is rich in protein and fiber. Foxtail millet, popularly known as Navane in Karnataka or Kakum in Hindi is high in carbohydrates and has minerals such as copper & iron. Yes, Millets are nutritious but that’s not all - they also add crunchy texture making the product NON-STICKY. Storage: Store away from direct heat or sunlight. Usage: Take half cup (38 g) of Masala Oats from the pack. Add 1.5 cups (250 ml) of water to it. Cook on a medium flame for 4 minutes while stirring continuously. If microwaving, cook the product for 4 minutes and stir occasionally. Serve hot. Add vegetables & garnish if necessary.

  • WHOLESOME GOODNESS OF MILLETS: Enjoy a bowl of wholesome goodness with Tata Soulfull Masala Oats+ which has 25% millets (Navane and Jowar)
